# sPOLAR

> Stake POLAR to receive sPOLAR and participate in protocol stewardship.

Canonical URL: https://docs.polaris.finance/testnet/sPOLAR

---

This is where you stake POLAR to receive sPOLAR.

From here you can create and manage your staked positions, monitor your voting power and rewards, and participate in protocol stewardship.

Each position is created independently, letting you choose a different amount and staking period for every position.

![A walkthrough of staking POLAR into a new sPOLAR position.](https://docs.polaris.finance/videos/testnet/spolar-poster.jpg)
